independence_evidence.scope: Prior metadata inventory, audited report, local source-code/report references and current Downloads filenames. Not a full computer/chat/access-history forensic proof.

unknown_count_reason: No requested-year source CSV is parsed and official calendars/quality/rollovers have not been verified; weekdays are NOT exchange sessions or eligible days.
interpretation: No zero-PnL fabrication: unselected/closed/failed-quality slots are zero moment-scores, not selected zero-return observations.

required_quality.strict_shared_sample: Require complete normal RTH09:30-15:59 plus09:29 boundary, all selection and both horizon labels; valid prior ATR14. Official early-close sessions are not vendor corruption but cannot enter the full-RTH shared sample.
required_quality.warmup: Only 14 prior valid complete RTH true ranges in the frozen continuous point-in-time context; no current or future returns. Carry history across guard dates; no artificial reset at a statistical block boundary.
required_quality.official_calendar: MUST_VERIFY_BEFORE_OUTCOME_RELEASE; 2018 warmup and2019-2021 holidays, early closes, extraordinary halts and both DST transitions each year. Do not classify every weekday as an exchange session.
required_quality.raw: Individual unadjusted contracts. Deduplicate identical contract/timestamp bars; conflicting overlaps fail. Never fill missing OHLCV or move a timestamp to improve an effect.
required_quality.roll: Use frozen volume crossover logic: new contract exceeds old completed-session volume, activate next trading session; last common completed RTH close before activation for causal additive Panama context. Never switch on returns. If evidence unavailable, mark DATA_INSUFFICIENT, no calendar-roll fallback. Raw prices remain unadjusted for horizons.
required_quality.minimum_information: >=120 selected common observations total and >=8 in each fixed inference block; no event-count extension.
required_quality.hashes: Lock all sourceSHA256, calendar, volume decisions, partitions, quality and adaptation-parity BEFORE any new outcomes are scored.

no_peeking: One final fixed-end run only after explicit release; no peeking, event-count extension, date replacement, alternative window selection or merging discovery/replication p-values. Missing-information result stays inconclusive. Execution remains independently unverified.
